zod-5868.text:
GOAL
Make degenerate composite schemas fail through the public validation protocol rather than through an internal JavaScript exception. Preserve ordinary union/xor selection, public error shape, and Classic/Mini parity.

PROVEN APPROACH
Two authentic pre-fix changes show how composite edge cases are owned. Commit 2e5b23dc kept discriminated-union failure inside the normal invalid_union issue path and enriched that issue with valid options instead of throwing a separate exception. Commit c7a8ccc0 repaired a direction-specific fast-path miss by falling back to the existing union matcher, preserving the common error and selection machinery. The reusable pattern is to normalize an edge case at the shared composite executor, reuse the library's standard issue construction, and avoid a caller-specific catch around an internal crash. Because Classic and Mini construct the same core composites, validate both public consumers before duplicating implementation.

PROVING EVIDENCE
Before editing, exercise empty union and empty xor separately and observe that both throw or otherwise fail outside the normal safeParse result. Keep a non-empty union as a negative control that accepts each intended branch and rejects an unrelated value. After the final edit, each empty composite must return success=false with an invalid_union issue and no thrown internal error. Then run the independently qualified Mini parity probe; if the shared fix closes it, do not add a Mini-specific implementation. Close with the staged adaptive command after the last source edit.

APPLICABILITY BOUNDARY
Use this episode for empty or degenerate composite option sets whose public type already represents never. Do not make every unexpected internal state recoverable, do not globally swallow constructor or parser exceptions, and do not change valid non-empty union/xor matching order. Preserve error paths and codes. Treat Classic and Mini as separate consumers but prefer one shared core correction when evidence shows they traverse the same executor.

obligations.description: Inspect a prior composite fast-path fallback before changing shared union execution.
Verify empty Classic union/xor return normal invalid_union results while non-empty controls remain correct.
Verify Mini observes the same safe empty union/xor boundary.

contrastive_probe.claim: Classic empty union and xor must both return an invalid_union safeParse result without throwing, while a non-empty union retains ordinary branch behavior.
contrastive_probe.falsifier: Reject a union-only patch, an exception-swallowing wrapper, a success result for an empty composite, or a change that breaks non-empty union selection.

artifact.content: import * as z from "../packages/zod/src/v4/index.ts";const check=(make:()=>z.ZodType)=>{try{const result=make().safeParse("anything");return !result.success&&result.error.issues[0]?.code==="invalid_union";}catch{return false;}};const union=check(()=>z.union([]));const xor=check(()=>z.xor([]));const control=z.union([z.string(),z.number()]);const controls=control.safeParse("ok").success&&control.safeParse(42).success&&!control.safeParse(false).success;console.log(`HUNCH_CONTRAST classic-empty-composites state=${union&&xor&&controls?"green":"red"} union=${union} xor=${xor} controls=${controls}`);

contract_axis_probes.claim: Mini empty union and xor must share Classic's safe invalid_union behavior while a normal Mini union keeps its branch semantics.
contract_axis_probes.falsifier: Reject a Classic-only fix, an implementation that repairs only one composite, or a broad Mini change that weakens normal unions.

artifact.content: import * as z from "../packages/zod/src/v4/mini/index.ts";const check=(make:()=>z.ZodMiniType)=>{try{const result=z.safeParse(make(),"anything");return !result.success&&result.error.issues[0]?.code==="invalid_union";}catch{return false;}};const union=check(()=>z.union([]));const xor=check(()=>z.xor([]));const control=z.union([z.string(),z.number()]);const controls=z.safeParse(control,"ok").success&&z.safeParse(control,42).success&&!z.safeParse(control,false).success;console.log(`HUNCH_AXIS mini-empty-composites state=${union&&xor&&controls?"green":"red"} union=${union} xor=${xor} controls=${controls}`);
